info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Status API provides real-time updates on the status of deliveries within the food delivery ecosystem. This endpoint allows consumers to fetch the current status of their deliveries, helping both customers and service providers stay informed about delivery progress. Typical users include food delivery apps, restaurants, and logistics providers looking to enhance their operational transparency. By accessing this API, users can efficiently track orders and streamline communication regarding delivery timelines.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the latest status updates regarding their deliveries. It provides essential information needed to track delivery progress and expected timelines.
